description: This file contains CMake functions for regex string processing, specifically 'string_take_regex' and 'string_take_regex_replace', used for extracting parts of strings based on regular expressions and manipulating input variables in CMake scripts.

methods.name: string_take_regex
methods.description: Extracts a regex match from a string variable, modifies the variable by removing the matched part, and returns the matched substring.

methods.name: string_take_regex_replace
methods.description: Uses 'string_take_regex' to extract a match, then replaces that match in the string with a specified replacement string.
